name: Single-Leg Romanian Deadlift
cues: Hold the dumbbell in the hand opposite your standing leg
Hinge forward as your free leg reaches straight back
Keep your hips square to the floor
Keep a soft bend in the standing knee
Drive your standing heel down to come back up
